edge.name: Momentum
edge.desc: Every blow that lands adds one. Taking a blow loses one. Each pip is +4% damage; at five the next ability or heavy blow is a Crushing Blow that knocks them flat.

mortals.name: Headsman’s Verdict
mortals.desc: A leaping two-handed blow that ends the bout and most of the opponent.

mortals.name: Through the Wall
mortals.desc: One blow sends them the length of the pit. The second arrives before they stop sliding.

mortals.name: Earthbreaker
mortals.desc: Three strikes that split the floor, and a fourth that drops them into it.

mortals.name: The Headsman
mortals.desc: Two cuts to turn them, one to finish. The head lands somewhere in the cheap seats.

mortals.name: Nailed to the Sand
mortals.desc: Every blade off the pit wall, called down point first.

mortals.name: Off With It
mortals.desc: Two cuts, the head is gone, and a boot in the chest sends what is left across the sand.

mortals.name: Down the Middle
mortals.desc: One stroke from crown to belt. The halves take a moment to agree to part.

mortals.name: Split to the Belt
mortals.desc: Three turns of the blade and they are two people, neither of them well.

mortals.name: Bent the Wrong Way
mortals.desc: The elbow, the knee, the other knee, and then the neck, in that order, each the way it does not go.

edge.name: Openings
edge.desc: A perfect dodge or a parry adds two; a blow lands for one, or two from the side or behind. At five your next blow is a guaranteed critical.

mortals.name: Death of a Thousand Cuts
mortals.desc: Seven cuts from seven directions before the body knows to fall.

mortals.name: The Quiet Word
mortals.desc: You are in front of them. Then you are not. One thrust, a long pause, and it is over.

mortals.name: Rain of Knives
mortals.desc: Every blade you own, from every direction at once.

mortals.name: The Red Smile
mortals.desc: You are behind them. They work it out a moment after their head does.

mortals.name: Strung Up
mortals.desc: A wire nobody saw you throw. They go up kicking and come down quiet.

mortals.name: Trip and Tread
mortals.desc: A heel behind the knee, and then a heel somewhere worse.

mortals.name: Souvenir
mortals.desc: You take the head and leave the rest standing. Then you kick it over, for the look of the thing.

mortals.name: Pinned Like a Moth
mortals.desc: A knife through each place that matters, and they are left standing because they cannot fall.

mortals.name: Every String Cut
mortals.desc: Wrists, elbows, knees. You cut whatever holds them up and let them fold.

edge.name: Overcharge
edge.desc: Every spell adds one. At five the next spell is Overcharged for +45% damage.

mortals.name: Disintegrate
mortals.desc: A green ray that leaves a fine grey dust and a scorch mark.

mortals.name: Meteor Swarm
mortals.desc: Four burning stones, called down one after another onto the same unlucky spot.

mortals.name: Chain Lightning
mortals.desc: Every bolt in the vault finds the same body.

mortals.name: Burn From Within
mortals.desc: They rise off the sand, lit from the inside like a lantern.

mortals.name: Unzip the World
mortals.desc: The floor opens on somewhere that is not the Undercity. It takes them and closes.

mortals.name: Glass Statue
mortals.desc: They go pale, then blue, then very still. Then you flick them.

mortals.name: Unstrung
mortals.desc: You hold them in the air and take them apart, a limb at a time, like a puppet you are tired of.

mortals.name: Rendered Down
mortals.desc: You hold the heat on them and do not stop. They slump, and run, and soak into the sand.

mortals.name: The Kiln
mortals.desc: Not a burst. A slow, even heat, until they are the colour of a pot.

mortals.name: Boiled in the Skin
mortals.desc: You heat everything they are made of at once. Their joints jump. Then there is too much of them for the skin.

edge.name: Devotion
edge.desc: Every blow that lands adds one. At five the Light answers: you heal a tenth of your health and take a ward.

mortals.name: Flame Strike
mortals.desc: A column of the Light Beneath, called straight down.

mortals.name: Banishing Smite
mortals.desc: Three rings of light close in, and the mace sends what is left somewhere else.

mortals.name: Power Word Kill
mortals.desc: A single word. Nobody in the stands hears it. Everybody sees what it does.

mortals.name: Taken Up
mortals.desc: The Light lifts them gently. It does not set them down gently.

mortals.name: Hammer of the Faithful
mortals.desc: Three rings of light to hold them still, and one swing to send the head ahead of the soul.

mortals.name: Heel of the Faithful
mortals.desc: They are put on the ground, and shown the sole of your boot, and the Light Beneath.

mortals.name: Cast Out
mortals.desc: The head for the Chapel. The body you put out with your foot.

mortals.name: A Pillar of Salt
mortals.desc: You tell them not to look. They look. They go white from the eyes outward, and then they break.

mortals.name: Rung Like a Bell
mortals.desc: You lift them into the light and bring them down on the stone, headfirst, twice.

mortals.name: Made to Pray
mortals.desc: On their knees, hands raised to the Light. You accept the prayer on its behalf.

edge.name: Wild Bond
edge.desc: Every blow that lands adds one. At five your next blow roots them to the spot for a second and a half.

mortals.name: The Pack Feeds
mortals.desc: You are a wolf for exactly as long as it takes.

mortals.name: Taken by the Roots
mortals.desc: The sand opens. Something pale and patient pulls them under, and it closes again.

mortals.name: Three From the Dark
mortals.desc: You whistle. Three shapes come up out of the sand with their ears back, and you let them.

mortals.name: The Old Bear
mortals.desc: A shape off a cave wall, twice the height of a man, for one blow.

mortals.name: A Thousand Wings
mortals.desc: Every bat in the roost, all at once, for about a second.

mortals.name: Hung in the Web
mortals.desc: Up into the dark on a silk line, to something that has been waiting patiently.

mortals.name: Thrown to the Pack
mortals.desc: Lifted off the sand and flung the width of the pit, to whatever is waiting there.

mortals.name: Rent in Two
mortals.desc: Whatever you are for that one second has claws long enough.

mortals.name: Fed to the Beast
mortals.desc: If you are not already an animal you become one, and eat them. What comes out the other side is not much.

mortals.name: Grown Through
mortals.desc: Six thorns come up through the sand, and through the feet, the hands and the neck, and keep growing.

edge.name: Debt
edge.desc: Every spell adds one, and each pip is +3% damage. At five your next blow collects: you heal half of what it deals.

mortals.name: Paid in Full
mortals.desc: Your patron reaches up through the sand and takes what it is owed.

mortals.name: The Maw Below
mortals.desc: A ring of teeth opens in the floor of the pit. It is gone before the crowd can agree on what they saw.

mortals.name: Speak the Name
mortals.desc: You say the thing you promised never to say aloud.

mortals.name: Folded Away
mortals.desc: Your patron closes its hand. They get smaller, and smaller, and then there is a noise.

mortals.name: Pulled Apart
mortals.desc: Many hands, each with a firm grip and its own idea of which way to go.

mortals.name: Many Hands
mortals.desc: They come out of the shadows under the stands. There are a great many of them.

mortals.name: It Looked Back
mortals.desc: For one moment your patron pays attention. Nothing it looks at survives being seen.

mortals.name: Unpicked
mortals.desc: Your patron finds the loose thread and pulls. They come undone upward, in ribbons, until there is nothing to hold the shape.

mortals.name: The Gnawing
mortals.desc: The dark eats them from the feet up, patiently, and leaves a stain.

mortals.name: What Was Owed
mortals.desc: The floor opens just wide enough. Something below has been keeping an account.

mortals.name: Danced to Death
mortals.desc: Your patron lends you the strings. They dance for the stands until the strings are taken back.

rogue.desc: Disappear for 3s and move faster. Your next hit is a Sneak Attack.

rogue.name: Throwing Knife
rogue.desc: A cantrip of the trade: one fast knife for 1d6 + DEX. Cheap, quick, always ready.

rogue.name: Flurry of Shadows
rogue.desc: Blink through your foe four times. Each pass deals 2d6 + DEX.

rogue.name: Bear Trap
rogue.desc: Set iron jaws where you stand. The first to step in takes 2d6 + DEX and is held for 1.4s.

rogue.name: Open Them Up
rogue.desc: In close and under the ribs: 3d6 + DEX, and they keep bleeding for 4s.

rogue.name: Tumble
rogue.desc: Roll out of trouble, and keep moving faster for 2s.

rogue.name: Exploit
rogue.desc: Spend all your Openings in one cut: 3d6 + DEX, +35% for every pip spent, and a full five bleeds them for 5s.

rogue.name: Caltrops
rogue.desc: A handful of iron points where they are about to step: slowed for 4s and bleeding.

sorcerer.name: Burning Hands
sorcerer.desc: A sheet of flame: 3d6 + CHA in a cone, then burning for 3s.

sorcerer.name: Misty Step
sorcerer.desc: Teleport a short distance in silver mist. Untouchable while you travel.

sorcerer.name: Lightning Bolt
sorcerer.desc: After a brief charge, a bolt strikes everything in a line for 3d8 + CHA.

sorcerer.name: Ray of Frost
sorcerer.desc: A frigid lance for 2d8 + CHA that slows by 50% for 3s.

sorcerer.name: Glyph of Warding
sorcerer.desc: Scribe a sigil underfoot. When your foe crosses it: 4d6 + CHA, burning, and thrown back.

sorcerer.name: Fireball
sorcerer.desc: A bead of fire streaks out and detonates: 6d6 + CHA in a huge area.

sorcerer.name: Shocking Grasp
sorcerer.desc: For when they get close: 2d8 + CHA, a jolt that stuns, and a long shove away.

sorcerer.name: Thunderwave
sorcerer.desc: A clap of thunder from your hands: 2d8 + CHA around you, and everything near is thrown back.

sorcerer.name: Scorching Ray
sorcerer.desc: A fast line of fire: 2d6 + CHA, and they burn for 3s.

sorcerer.name: Release
sorcerer.desc: Let all your Overcharge out at once around you: 3d8 + CHA, +35% for every pip spent.

sorcerer.name: Shatter
sorcerer.desc: A ringing crack in the air where they stand: 3d8 + CHA.

cleric.name: Sacred Flame
cleric.desc: Radiance descends on your foe after a moment: 2d8 + WIS.

cleric.name: Shield of Faith
cleric.desc: A shimmering ward absorbs damage for 6s (22 + 5 per level).

cleric.name: Guiding Bolt
cleric.desc: A flash of light for 3d6 + WIS. The target takes 25% more damage for 4s.

cleric.name: Toll the Dead
cleric.desc: A cantrip: a bell only they can hear. 1d12 + WIS, doubled against a foe below 40% health.

cleric.name: Spirit Guardians
cleric.desc: Spectral guardians circle you for 7s, dealing 1d8 + WIS twice a second and slowing foes inside.

cleric.name: Guardian Sigil
cleric.desc: Bless the ground you hold. Whoever crosses it takes 3d8 + WIS and is stunned.

cleric.name: Spiritual Hammer
cleric.desc: A hammer of light comes down on them from nowhere: 2d8 + WIS and a short stun.

cleric.name: Sanctuary
cleric.desc: A ward, a little mending and lighter feet: a shield, 1d6 + WIS health, and 20% speed for 3s.

cleric.name: Sanctify
cleric.desc: Spend all your Devotion: heal 2d8 + WIS, and a ward of 8 for every pip spent.

cleric.name: Bane
cleric.desc: A curse in a cone: everything you do to them for 5s lands 25% harder, and they move slower.

druid.name: Tunnel Wolf
druid.desc: Become a tunnel wolf for 9s: 28% faster, quick lunging bites, and your heavy blow is a pounce. You change back winded.

druid.name: Moonbeam
druid.desc: A column of pale light comes down on them: 2d10 + WIS.

druid.name: Cave Bear
druid.desc: Become a cave bear for 10s: a thick hide soaks 34 + 6 per level, slow sweeping mauls break posture, and you hit 20% harder.

druid.name: Pit Spider
druid.desc: Become a giant pit spider for 9s: every bite poisons and slows, and you skitter 12% faster.

druid.name: Regrowth
druid.desc: Moss closes over the wound: heal 2d8 + WIS + 2 per level.

druid.name: The Old Bear Wakes
druid.desc: Become the cave bear the first miners drew on the walls, for 12s: enormous, armoured in hide, and 35% deadlier.

druid.name: Barkskin
druid.desc: Your skin turns to root-bark for 6s and soaks 22 + 5 per level.

druid.name: Ice Knife
druid.desc: A shard of cave ice: 1d10 + WIS, and the cold slows them for 2s.

druid.name: Entangle
druid.desc: Roots come up through the sand where they stand: 1d6 + WIS and they are held to a crawl for 3s.

druid.name: Call of the Wild
druid.desc: Spend all your Wild Bond: the ground bites them for 2d8 + WIS, +35% and +0.3s held for every pip spent.

warlock.name: Hex
warlock.desc: Your patron marks them: 1d6 + CHA, and they take 25% more from everything for 6s.

warlock.name: Step Through the Dark
warlock.desc: Step into one shadow and out of another. Untouchable while you travel.

warlock.name: Arms of the Deep
warlock.desc: Cold black arms sweep out in a cone: 3d6 + CHA, and the cold keeps biting.

warlock.name: Cause Fear
warlock.desc: Show them what waits below: 2d8 + CHA, and they move like a man wading for 3s.

warlock.name: Armour of Shadows
warlock.desc: The dark thickens round you for 6s and soaks 22 + 5 per level.

warlock.name: The Bargain Called In
warlock.desc: What you sold comes to collect from somebody else: 6d6 + CHA in a huge area.

warlock.name: Hunger of the Pit
warlock.desc: A patch of black opens under them: 2d6 + CHA, slowed, and it keeps eating for 3s.

warlock.name: Fade Out
warlock.desc: Step back into the dark and out of sight for a moment.

warlock.name: Foreclose
warlock.desc: Call in all your Debt at once: 3d8 + CHA, +35% for every pip spent, and you heal a fifth of it.

move.name: Stubborn Streak
move.desc: Humans do not know when to stop. Heal 1d8 + CON + 2 per level and strike 25% faster for 3s.

move.name: Fey Step
move.desc: Step sideways out of the world and back in behind them. Your next blow lands as a sneak attack.

move.name: Stonefoot
move.desc: One boot, put down the way the Old Seam taught: 2d6 + CON around you, stunned and shoved. You cannot be knocked out of it.

move.name: Tusk Charge
move.desc: Head down, straight through: a long charge for 3d6 + STR that carries them into whatever is behind.

move.name: Hellish Flare
move.desc: What your grandmother bargained for: fire comes up under them for 2d8 + CHA and keeps burning for 4s.

move.name: Faerie Fire
move.desc: Cold violet light that will not rub off: 1d8 + DEX, slowed for 4s, and nowhere left to hide.

move.name: Headsman’s Due
move.desc: The blow you learned from being the one left standing: 3d8 + STR, doubled against a foe below 40% health.

move.name: Gone Again
move.desc: Ten bouts taught you where the crowd is not looking. Vanish for 2.5s, faster, with a sneak attack waiting.

move.name: Chain Lightning
move.desc: It stopped being one bolt somewhere around your eighth win: a wide line for 4d6 + CHA and a short stun.

move.name: Turn the Tide
move.desc: A proper prayer, for once answered: heal 3d8 + WIS + 3 per level and stand behind a ward for 6s.

move.name: The Crawling Dark
move.desc: Everything that lives under the sand comes up at once: 1d6 + WIS, then 5s of biting and slowing.

move.name: Collect
move.desc: Your patron takes its share and passes you a little: 3d6 + CHA, and half of it comes back to you as health.

beast.name: Bite
beast.desc: Tap to strike for 1d8 + WIS. Costs 5, refunded on a hit. Hold, then release, for a heavy blow.

beast.name: Maul
beast.desc: Tap to strike for 2d8 + WIS. Costs 11, refunded on a hit. Hold, then release, for a heavy blow.

beast.name: Venom Bite
beast.desc: Tap to strike for 1d6 + WIS. Costs 7, refunded on a hit. Hold, then release, for a heavy blow.

beast.name: Raking Dive
beast.desc: Tap to strike for 1d6 + WIS. Costs 5, refunded on a hit. Hold, then release, for a heavy blow.

beast.name: Ruin
beast.desc: Tap to strike for 3d8 + WIS. Costs 8, refunded on a hit. Hold, then release, for a heavy blow.

races.name: Human
races.desc: +1 to every ability. Adaptable, hungry, everywhere.

races.name: Dwarf
races.desc: +2 Constitution, +1 Wisdom. Born under stone and hard to put down.

races.name: Elf
races.desc: +2 Dexterity, +1 Intelligence. Quick hands, long memory.

races.name: Half-Orc
races.desc: +2 Strength, +1 Constitution. The pit crowd loves a bruiser.

races.name: Tiefling
races.desc: +2 Charisma, +1 Intelligence. Infernal blood, and an infernal spirit that answers when you taunt: hellhound, ember cat or carrion crow.

races.name: Drow
races.desc: +2 Dexterity, +1 Charisma. Deep elves: ash skin, white hair, red eyes. The only people in the Undercity who think it is too bright.
